summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for BEOVU (brolucizumab, BLA761125). The original approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the biologic was not the first product licensed for neovascular age-related macular degeneration and the safety/efficacy data did not raise unexpected issues for this class. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
